subject: Questionnaire path evaluation, HIPAA scope & next steps
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: questionnaire path evaluation, HIPAA scope & next steps

Hi Alex — thanks again for the demo today, appreciate the time. A couple quick items from our side so we can get the security process moving: 

1) Questionnaire type: we typically support SIG Lite, full SIG, CAIQ, or a short custom prefill. To make sure we send the right package, can you confirm whether your security team prefers the SIG framework or CAIQ as a first pass? If you have a template you use internally, please share.

2) HIPAA & PHI: you mentioned PHI may be involved for a subset of workflows. Can you confirm whether the initial pilot will include PHI in-scope (e.g., 1–2 integrations), or if PHI will be out of scope for the pilot and only in scope at production? This affects evidence and the SOC 2 + BAA path.

3) SOC 2: do you need the latest SOC 2 Type II report up-front or is an SOC 2 readiness summary acceptable for the first pass?

4) Residency / network diagram: if you need EU-only processing or specific IP allowlists, we’ll attach a network diagram and our residency options.

Attached: Redwood_SIG_Prefill_Template.xlsx (blank prefill we can complete together).

Proposed next steps: you confirm SIG vs CAIQ preference + HIPAA scope by EOD Wednesday, we’ll prepare the requested package and propose a short handoff call with our security engineer if needed.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: Redwood_SIG_Prefill_Template.xlsx

Subject: Re: Post-demo: questionnaire path evaluation, HIPAA scope & next steps

Naomi — thanks, good recap. Quick answers: 

• Questionnaire: our security team generally prefers SIG full for vendor intake, but if SIG is a blocker we can accept a completed CAIQ for cloud services. Let’s start with the SIG full; if any sections are redundant we can prune.
• HIPAA: the pilot will include PHI (limited integration with our EHR sandbox). So HIPAA/BAA will be in scope from the pilot.
• SOC 2: we have a current SOC 2 Type II (report dated 2026-07). I’ve looped security@finovate.com into this thread to coordinate evidence exchange — they can share the control set they want validated.

I’m attaching our network diagram and the vendor intake form in case that helps. How long does it usually take for Redwood to fill the SIG prefill? Our security team is aiming for a 2-week turnaround.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Torres
Director, Product Security | Finovate

I’ve attached the prefill and included links: Drive prefill (https://drive.google.com/finovate-prefill) and HubSpot record HS-3245.
